title: 第17章 美女老师的火系第18章 队友很重要
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 唐月此时还保持着一个非常笔挺的站姿静立在那里，优美曲线的身段在那略窄的裙装下勾勒得格外动人，也许刚来任教，衣裳的选择上太过匆忙才会如此吧，却是让学生们大饱眼福。
“要静心，要平和，要专注，哪怕我现在在跟你们说话，我的精神也完全专注在我的火系星云之中……哦，星尘之中。”唐月老师说道。
唐月老师的声音传入到每一位学生的耳中，当大家感觉唐月老师静立在那里宛如一尊雕塑的时候，忽然她那梨花卷发出现了一些波动。
整个操场内是没有一丝风的，她的发丝却好像在一股热气中扩散开！
“掌控，此刻你就是呼唤者，让你的星子听从你的指令，为你开启火系魔能之门！！”唐月老师的声音从之前的柔和忽然变成了得肃然，甚至带着几分一切都将在她面前付之一炬的傲性！
这一瞬间，所有脑子里充满龌龊念头的男学生们都怔住了。
他们瞪大了双眼，有些惊骇的看着这位美女老师。
气息！！
是的，他们感觉到了从唐月老师身上散发出来的火辣辣气息，扑打在大家的脸上。
有惊讶，有敬畏，还有令人无法心生亵渎的不怒自威！
大家本以为这位刚来的唐月老师也不过是一个很普通的老师，能够交给大家的跟那个连老头一样就是一些乌七八糟的理论，等到自己亲自施展魔法时还可能出错，然而眼前这位年轻的唐月老师却宛如已经掌控这股力量很久很久，她能够一边教导，一边掌控星子，当完成魔法起势之后，那涌出的火息和连老头根本不是一个级别的，简直一个火苗一个火柱！
“记住，完成星子排列后，决不能就此松懈你的精神，一定要立刻锁定你释放的位置！！”
那个威严的声音再一次传来。
“火滋?灼烧！”
音如魔钟，颤响在众人的脑海之中。
同一时间，唐月老师周身出现了一道赤红色醒目的星之轨迹，从她周围一闪而逝之后，迅速凝聚在了她那白皙玉润的右手上。
伴随着她的手掌半握，一团炙热的红色能量在她手掌上迅速滋长，无比暴躁！
手臂猛力甩出！
那团火焰如离弦之箭飞出，在空气中惊起了赤红的娇艳，然后如子弹一般准确无误的贯穿到了木偶的身体里！
“没了？”
“怎么没动静？”
“明明射中了啊。”
气氛兀然沉寂了一秒，那被火滋命中的木偶并没有任何反应，和唐月老师释放的气势倒成了鲜明的反比。
一片质疑声中，唐月老师缓缓的转过身来，面对着全班48名还显得几分稚嫩的面孔，嘴角却勾起了一个自信飞扬的笑意。
猛然间，一片触目惊心的赤红在那木偶身体内窜起，绝不是那种缓慢的引燃，而是疯狂的飞舞，像是要将一切可以燃烧的东西都一口气焚尽！
刚才还完好无损的人形木偶顷刻间被赤红色火焰给吞没！！！！
1秒还是2秒？？
平常看到的火焰也不过是在飞舞，可这火焰却像是饥饿的野兽在吞噬，2秒的时间都不到，整个人形木偶就被吞噬得一干二净！！
刺目的红光映红了唐月老师那漂亮的梨花卷发，白皙的脸在此刻更是染得嫣红动人。
唇角扬起的那一抹笑容，背后却是一朵肆意燃烧的火焰，衬得这位原本就艳丽照人的老师只能够用一个句来形容——美得不可方物！
全班48名学生都看呆了。
content_en:
At this time, Tang Yue was still standing there with a very upright posture. Her graceful and curvy figure was particularly moving under the slightly narrow skirt. Maybe she had just come to teach and was too hasty in the choice of clothes, but it was a feast for the eyes of the students.
"Be meditative, be peaceful, and be focused. Even if I am talking to you now, my spirit is completely focused on my fire nebula...oh, stardust." Teacher Tang Yue said.
Teacher Tang Yue's voice reached the ears of every student. When everyone felt that Teacher Tang Yue was standing there quietly like a sculpture, suddenly there were some fluctuations in her pear blossom curly hair.
There was no wind in the entire playground, but her hair seemed to be spreading in a wave of heat!
"Control, you are the caller at this moment, let your star obey your instructions and open the door of fire magic energy for you!!" Teacher Tang Yue's voice suddenly changed from the softness before to awe-inspiring, even with a bit of arrogance that everything would be burned in front of her!
At this moment, all the male students who were filled with dirty thoughts were stunned.
Their eyes widened and they looked at the beautiful teacher with some horror.
breath! !
Yes, they felt the hot breath emanating from Teacher Tang Yue hitting everyone's faces.
There is surprise, awe, and a sense of self-restraint that makes people unable to feel blasphemy!
Everyone thought that the newly arrived teacher Tang Yue was just an ordinary teacher. What he could give everyone was just the same messy theories as Old Man Lian, and he might still make mistakes when he performed the magic himself. However, the young teacher Tang Yue in front of them seemed to have been in control of this power for a long time. She could teach and control the stars at the same time. After the magic was activated, the fire breath that came out was not at the same level as Old Man Lian. It was like a flame and a fire pillar!
"Remember, after completing the arrangement of the stars, you must not relax your spirit, and you must immediately lock the position where you release it!!"
That majestic voice came again.
"Fire? Burning!"
The sound was like a magic bell, vibrating in everyone's minds.
At the same time, a red and eye-catching star trail appeared around Teacher Tang Yue. After passing around her, it quickly condensed on her fair and jade-skinned right hand.
As she half-clasped her palms, a ball of hot red energy grew rapidly on her palms, extremely violent!
Throw the arm out violently!
The flame flew out like an arrow from a string, stirring up a red beauty in the air, and then penetrated the puppet's body accurately like a bullet!
"No more?"
"Why is there no movement?"
"It's obviously a hit."
The atmosphere suddenly fell silent for a second, and the puppet hit by the fire did not react at all, which was in stark contrast to the momentum released by Teacher Tang Yue.
Amidst the questioning, Teacher Tang Yue slowly turned around and faced the 48 young faces in the class, but a confident smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
"Hoo ho ho ho!!!!!!!!"
Suddenly, a shocking crimson burst out of the puppet's body. It was definitely not a slow ignition, but a crazy dance, as if it was going to burn everything that could be burned in one breath!
The humanoid puppet that was intact just now was instantly engulfed by red flames! ! ! !
1 second or 2 seconds? ?
The flames we usually see are just flying, but this flame is like a hungry beast devouring it. In less than 2 seconds, the entire human puppet is swallowed up! !
The dazzling red light reflected Teacher Tang Yue's beautiful pear-shaped curly hair, and her fair face was even more vividly dyed red at this moment.
The smile that raised at the corner of his lips was a burning flame behind it, which made this already gorgeous teacher only be described in one sentence - incredibly beautiful!
All 48 students in the class were stunned.
title_en: Chapter 17 The Fire Element of the Beautiful Teacher Chapter 18 Teammates are very important
